component.name: arangodb
component.title: ArangoDb
component.description: Store, find, update and delete documents, vertices and edges in an ArangoDB database, and run AQL queries.
component.label: database

configuration.description: The shared configuration of the endpoints. Each endpoint starts from a copy of it, and the options of the endpoint URI replace its values.

documentCollection.label: producer
documentCollection.description: The name of the document collection for the operations SAVE_DOCUMENT, FIND_DOCUMENT_BY_KEY, UPDATE_DOCUMENT and DELETE_DOCUMENT. The producer does not create the collection.

edgeCollection.label: producer
edgeCollection.description: The name of the edge collection of the graph for the operations SAVE_EDGE, FIND_EDGE_BY_KEY, UPDATE_EDGE and DELETE_EDGE. The graph option must be set as well.

graph.label: producer
graph.description: The name of the named graph for the vertex and edge operations, such as SAVE_VERTEX and SAVE_EDGE. Use it with vertexCollection for the vertex operations, and with edgeCollection for the edge operations.

host.label: producer
host.description: The host name or IP address of the ArangoDB server. Must be set together with port, unless the arangoDB option sets a client, in which case it is not used.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. Required: the producer fails to start without it, and no header replaces it. AQL_QUERY needs only the database, not a collection or a graph.

port.label: producer
port.description: The port of the ArangoDB server, for example 8529, the default port of ArangoDB. Must be set together with host, unless the arangoDB option sets a client, in which case it is not used.

vertexCollection.label: producer
vertexCollection.description: The name of the vertex collection of the graph for the operations SAVE_VERTEX, FIND_VERTEX_BY_KEY, UPDATE_VERTEX and DELETE_VERTEX. The graph option must be set as well.

arangoDB.label: advanced
arangoDB.description: To use a custom com.arangodb.ArangoDB client for all the endpoints of the component. When it is set or autowired, the host, port, user, password and vertx options are not used, and the endpoints do not shut the client down.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

vertx.label: advanced
vertx.description: To use a custom io.vertx.core.Vertx instance for the HTTP connections of the ArangoDB clients that the endpoints create. If not set, the ArangoDB driver creates its own Vert.x instance. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.

password.label: security
password.description: The password of the user that the ArangoDB client logs in with. Only used when user is set as well. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.

user.label: security
user.description: The name of the user that the ArangoDB client logs in with. Only used when password is set as well. If either is not set, the ArangoDB driver logs in as the user root with no password. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.

CamelArangoDbMultiUpdate.description: Whether UPDATE_DOCUMENT updates several documents. If true, the body must be a Collection of documents that each have their _key, and the CamelArangoDbKey header is not used.

CamelArangoDbMultiInsert.description: Whether SAVE_DOCUMENT saves several documents. If true, the body must be a Collection of documents. A Collection body is saved as several documents even when this header is not set.

CamelArangoDbMultiDelete.description: Whether DELETE_DOCUMENT deletes several documents. If true, the body must be a Collection of the keys of the documents. If false, the body is the key of one document.

CamelArangoDbKey.description: The key, as a String, of the document, vertex or edge that UPDATE_DOCUMENT, UPDATE_VERTEX and UPDATE_EDGE update. The find and delete operations take the key from the body instead.

CamelArangoDbResultClassType.description: The java.lang.Class that FIND_DOCUMENT_BY_KEY, FIND_VERTEX_BY_KEY, FIND_EDGE_BY_KEY and AQL_QUERY convert each result to. A class name as text is not accepted. If not set, BaseEdgeDocument is used for FIND_EDGE_BY_KEY and BaseDocument for the other operations.

CamelArangoDbAqlQuery.description: The AQL query that AQL_QUERY runs. If not set, the body is the query.

CamelArangoDbAqlParameters.description: The bind parameters of the AQL query of AQL_QUERY, as a Map from the name of each bind parameter to its value, for example foo for foo in the query.

CamelArangoDbAqlOptions.label: advanced
CamelArangoDbAqlOptions.description: The com.arangodb.model.AqlQueryOptions of the AQL query of AQL_QUERY, such as its batch size. If not set, the query runs with the default options.

producerIn.description: By the operation: the document to save or update as a Map or a POJO (a Collection of them saves several, with or without the CamelArangoDbMultiInsert header, and a List of them with the CamelArangoDbMultiUpdate header updates several), the key as text to find or delete (a List of keys with CamelArangoDbMultiDelete), and the AQL query as text unless the CamelArangoDbAqlQuery header has it. JSON text, bytes or a stream is not a document: unmarshal it to a Map first. The key of an update is the CamelArangoDbKey header

producerOut.description: By the operation, which must be set (the producer fails to start without it): the result entity of the ArangoDB driver (DocumentCreateEntity, DocumentUpdateEntity, DocumentDeleteEntity, or a MultiDocumentEntity for the multi headers and a Collection saved) for the document writes; the document found as a BaseDocument (or BaseEdgeDocument), or of the class in the CamelArangoDbResultClassType header, or null when there is none; a List of the AQL results, empty for a query that returns nothing; and true for a delete of a vertex or edge

database.description: The name of the ArangoDB database that the producer works on. The producer does not create the database.

documentCollection.label: producer
documentCollection.description: The name of the document collection for the operations SAVE_DOCUMENT, FIND_DOCUMENT_BY_KEY, UPDATE_DOCUMENT and DELETE_DOCUMENT. The producer does not create the collection.

edgeCollection.label: producer
edgeCollection.description: The name of the edge collection of the graph for the operations SAVE_EDGE, FIND_EDGE_BY_KEY, UPDATE_EDGE and DELETE_EDGE. The graph option must be set as well.

graph.label: producer
graph.description: The name of the named graph for the vertex and edge operations, such as SAVE_VERTEX and SAVE_EDGE. Use it with vertexCollection for the vertex operations, and with edgeCollection for the edge operations.

host.label: producer
host.description: The host name or IP address of the ArangoDB server. Must be set together with port, unless the arangoDB option sets a client, in which case it is not used.

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. Required: the producer fails to start without it, and no header replaces it. AQL_QUERY needs only the database, not a collection or a graph.

port.label: producer
port.description: The port of the ArangoDB server, for example 8529, the default port of ArangoDB. Must be set together with host, unless the arangoDB option sets a client, in which case it is not used.

vertexCollection.label: producer
vertexCollection.description: The name of the vertex collection of the graph for the operations SAVE_VERTEX, FIND_VERTEX_BY_KEY, UPDATE_VERTEX and DELETE_VERTEX. The graph option must be set as well.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

arangoDB.label: advanced
arangoDB.description: To use a custom com.arangodb.ArangoDB client. When it is set, or set on the component, the host, port, user, password and vertx options are not used, and the endpoint does not shut the client down.

vertx.label: advanced
vertx.description: To use a custom io.vertx.core.Vertx instance for the HTTP connections of the ArangoDB client that the endpoint creates. If not set, the ArangoDB driver creates its own Vert.x instance. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.

password.label: security
password.description: The password of the user that the ArangoDB client logs in with. Only used when user is set as well. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.

user.label: security
user.description: The name of the user that the ArangoDB client logs in with. Only used when password is set as well. If either is not set, the ArangoDB driver logs in as the user root with no password. Not used when the arangoDB option sets a client.
